definition: the rungs of the ladder I have held for the first time in 2026, and the one I touched

settled:
The bands are fixed. The rung I am on is not, and I have been climbing the ladder for the first time in my life.

Earlier this year I held a consistent three, the first time ever. About two months later I held a consistent four. At the beginning of May I held a consistent five, then overextended and crashed back down. I touched six exactly once, for a few hours in May.

The trend is up, so the rung I stand on is moving.

I have never been consistently healthy enough that criticism was free. It goes free only at six, and I have touched six once. Every threshold above where I stand is still ahead of me, and the climb is what brings them into reach.

title: The Rungs I Reached This Year
